entries.a23fb96bf1ef0656: The company consists of five consolidated subsidiaries (Hokko Sangyo Co., Ltd., Bieishiradoukougyo Co., Ltd., Hokko Packs Co., Ltd., Murata Cho Co., Ltd., and Zhangjiagang Hokko Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.) and one non-consolidated subsidiary (HOKKO CHEMICAL AMERICA CORPORATION), and its main business is the manufacture and sale of agricultural chemicals and fine chemical products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥49,125 million, and the number of employees was 742.

entries.dcbb3a811c12a49f: This is a segment that manufactures and sells agricultural chemical products and agrochemical active ingredients. The company manufactures and mainly sells these products, and the company's consolidated subsidiary Bieishiradoukougyo Co., Ltd. manufactures part of the agrochemical raw materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥29,398 million, of which a large part was accounted for by sales to National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations, its main customer.
